entries.name: Jalen Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks announced Monday in a story on his personal Instagram account that he underwent season-ending wrist surgery, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

entries.name: Tip Reiman
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur stated he's "not too sure" if Reiman (ankle) will play this season, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
entries.summary: The left knee injury that forced Jones out of Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts isn't considered significant, and the running back is viewed as day-to-day, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
entries.summary: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said that St. Brown tweaked his ankle during Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers but should be ready to practice Thursday, Richard Silva of The Detroit News reports.

entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) was active but didn't play any snaps Sunday in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

entries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Calvin Ridley
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Cam Skattebo
entries.summary: Skattebo is expected to "OK" after tweaking his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime during Sunday's 27-21 win over the Texans, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Christian McCaffrey
entries.summary: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

entries.name: Dameon Pierce
entries.summary: Pierce didn't take the field for either of the Eagles' final two possessions of Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys after sustaining an undisclosed injury with 8:38 remaining in the fourth quarter, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Erick All Jr.
entries.summary: All (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker was listed as limited on Monday's estimated practice report due to a shoulder injury, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle didn't return to Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals due to a chest injury, Parker Gabriel of the Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (quadriceps) left Sunday's game against the Jets and did not return to the contest.

entries.name: Jaylin Noel
entries.summary: Noel (toe) was seen in a walking boot after Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love (ankle) will take part in Wednesday's practice, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (concussion) was spotted on the field in a no-contact jersey during the Chargers' bonus practice session Monday, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Jackson (ankle) is "in a decent spot" to play Sunday against the Bills, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Mariota (knee) is on track to return to practice this week, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Matthew Golden
entries.summary: Golden (shoulder/foot) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's practice estimate, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

entries.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Rashid Shaheed
entries.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that the early returns on Shaheed's knee injury are positive, Brady Henderson reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley said after Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys that his "hamstring came out great," and noted that the back issue that kept him out for the entire fourth quarter isn't anything that he expects to prevent him from playing Sunday against the Commanders, Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyler Warren
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: Tracy (hamstring) didn't return to Sunday's 27-21 overtime win over the Texans after exiting with 5:29 remaining in the second quarter, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

entries.name: Beaux Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hip) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Brashard Smith
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Carter Runyon
entries.summary: The Raiders have ruled out Runyon (foot) for Sunday's game against the Rams.

entries.name: Cole Kmet
entries.summary: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (ankle) remains on track to return in December, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jack Bech
entries.summary: The Raiders designated Bech (forearm) for return from injured reserve Monday.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price (chest) will be designated for return from injured reserve during Week 8, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: When asked Monday if Conner (foot) will play this season, coach Mike LaFleur said "potentially," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said Tuesday that Tyson (hamstring) is "getting closer" but won't practice this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Tanner Hudson
entries.summary: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve next week, isn't expected to be ready at that time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tom Kennedy
entries.summary: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Tyler Badie
entries.summary: The Broncos placed Badie (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.
